parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'project_id', p.id,
  'project_name', p.name,
  'project_type', p.project_type,
  'current_phase', p.current_phase,
  'handover_date', p.handover_date,
  'days_since_handover', CASE WHEN p.handover_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - p.handover_date::timestamptz))/86400
    END,
  'client_id', p.client_id
) AS context
FROM projects p WHERE p.id = $1::uuid;

INSERT INTO aftercare_incidents (
  project_id, client_id, reporter, description, photo_urls,
  category, responsible_trade, severity, loe_period, under_warranty, days_since_handover,
  vision_summary, vision_raw, llm_model, llm_tokens_in, llm_tokens_out, llm_cost,
  client_contact
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, NULLIF($2,'')::uuid, $3, $4, $5::text[],
  $6, $7, $8, $9::int, $10::boolean, NULLIF($11,'')::int,
  $12, $13::jsonb, $14, $15::int, $16::int, $17::numeric,
  $18
) RETURNING id, status, severity, category, responsible_trade, under_warranty, loe_period;
UPDATE aftercare_incidents SET alert_sent = true WHERE id = $1::uuid;
